name: Allan van der Meulen
title: CEO
bio:
Zlto CEO, child of the Cape Flats, product of RLabs. That is how Allan describes himself, in that order.
He walked into RLabs as an intern in 2014 and spent two years building youth education content. In 2016 he co-founded Zlto, and he has run it as CEO since 2021. The platform turns volunteering into digital rewards people spend in real shops, so someone who gives a day to a community project can buy lunch that afternoon. It passed a million members this year.
On his own profile he writes that success should be earned, hard work rewarded, and that victory through deception is not an achievement. He has spent a decade building a company that does exactly that, for people the formal economy overlooks.
